verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Volumes provide persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances, directly matching the story. However, evidence is thin (a single doc line, no detailed workflow/pricing/limits) and a community comment notes it's still a hassle to work with persistent disks over time, indicating real friction in practice. missing for 10: detailed docs on volume creation/attach/reattach workflow, size/pricing/limits, and independent hands-on confirmation of reliability.
